data.gender_notes: Raiq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Ra'iqa' which means thunderbolt. This name is associated with power, strength, and wisdom. It is a name that is often given to boys who are believed to have great potential and a strong will. The name Raiq carries the meaning “thunderbolt” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Raiq usually hope their child will grow to embody thunderbolt and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the power and strength of Allah's creations, particularly the power of thunder and lightning. It is a reminder of Allah's power and wisdom, and a reminder to use one's own strength and wisdom wisely.
data.etymology: Raiq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “thunderbolt.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raiq total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
